newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-DYNAMO UPSET SPARTAK IN MOSCOW DERBY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DYNAMO UPSET SPARTAK IN MOSCOW DERBY.

text.p: Dynamo Moscow upset league leaders Spartak 2-1 in the big Moscow derby on Wednesday to climb back within striking distance of their city rivals in the Russian premier league.
Vladimir Skokov scored twice, once in each half, to clinch the win. The reigning champions replied with a 62nd-minute goal from Valery Kechinov.
Third-placed Dynamo are now just one point behind Spartak and Rotor Volgograd who are level on 31 points at the top of the table.
Volgograd failed to take advantage of the leaders' defeat and could only manage a 1-1 draw in Yaroslavl against mediocre Shinnik.
